'''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V7-L-sabinewren-2022-11-04-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V7-L-sabinewren-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V7-L-sabinewren-2022-11-04-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V7-L-sabinewren-2022-11-04.png]], 4 November 2022).
